title: post-merge-tech-debt-log
content:
Context:
- Quick after-action notes for PR #4382 (model-routing refactor). Merged yesterday. Left a handful of tidy-ups and medium-term refactor ideas that I don't want to lose.

Immediate quick wins (low effort):
- run eslint --fix on packages/router and packages/cli (there are ~18 autofixable issues).
  - command: node ./scripts/lint-staged.js && yarn eslint 'packages/**/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}' --fix
- collapse duplicate guard clauses in router/route-utils.ts (lines ~120-146) into a single normalizeRequest function. Small win for readability.
- remove unused export `LegacyRouter` (found in diff but not referenced anywhere) — confirm with code search before dropping.

PR review checklist (my personal checklist to use next time):
[ ] <50-file PRs preferred; if >100 files, add a review plan in PR description
[ ] Ensure a short summary: what changed, why, migration path, perf impact
[ ] Call out any schema/db changes and backwards compatibility notes
[ ] Tests: unit + one integration e2e where possible (CI should be green; if flaky tests, create issue)
[ ] Perf: run a local perf smoke (recorded command & baseline commit) if this touches runtime code
[ ] Security: secrets/keys not checked in, deps with high CVE flagged

Medium-term improvements (assign priority):
- P1: abstract router middlewares into named pipeline stages (makes canarying and metrics wiring easier). Sketch: pipeline: auth -> quota -> routing -> transform. Current code mixes auth/routing in same function. Estimate: 3-5d. Owner: Hana.
- P2: introduce a tiny test harness for routing decisions (table-driven tests) so we can add cases quickly. Estimate: 1-2d. Owner: Diego.
- P3: split model-mapping config file into per-region overrides. Not urgent but will reduce per-request lookups at scale. Estimate: 2-3d. Owner: Marta.

Technical debt log (actionable items to add to backlog):
- TD-01: inconsistent error types across packages (Error vs HttpError vs plain objects) — standardize to HttpError with code/message/metadata.
- TD-02: missing docstrings on public SDK surface (packages/sdk/src/index.ts) — this bites QA when debugging customer issues.
- TD-03: flaky test `routing-e2e` under high CI load — create a reproducible local script and file ticket.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Did the rollout metric (route.latency.p50) degrade by more than 5% in canary region? I saw a small blip on staging but not sure if noise. Action: Hana to pull 24h window and compare.
- Is the fallback routing behavior documented for Dedicated deployments? Not fully — need a one-pager for product. Owner: Diego (draft).

Notes to self (tech details to remember):
- When normalizing requests, preserve original headers X-Forwarded-For and X-Request-Id (used by SRE tracing).
- Avoid using JSON.parse on potentially large bodies synchronously; use streaming parser for >2MB payloads.

Follow-up TODOs (short):
- [ ] Create Jira ticket for TD-01 and link PR (#4382) — planned sprint 2025-11-10 (Diego).
- [ ] Run lint autofix and open cleanup PR (Hana) — target 2025-11-07.
- [ ] Draft product-facing doc about fallback routing (Diego) — target 2025-11-12.

Random scribbles / ideas (brainstorm):
- Could we add a router debug mode that logs resolution path (region, model-variant, fallback used) for 1% of requests? Would help debugging production confusion. Privacy check needed.
- Consider a small A/B test that compares cache-hit behavior when using prefix caching vs full KV caching for short prompts.

End of notes.
(These are informal — will migrate action items to Jira and tidy this doc when I have cycles.)
